title: What an Online Letter Costs, Line by Line
description: A one-page black-and-white letter is $3.49 all in: $2.00 mailing fee, $0.10 envelope, $0.15 printing and a $1.24 stamp. How each option changes the total.
keywords: how much does it cost to send a letter online
cost to mail a letter canada
answer: At sendletter, a one-page black-and-white letter in a #10 envelope costs $3.49: a $2.00 mailing fee, $0.10 for the envelope, $0.15 for printing and one $1.24 stamp, with tax included. Colour printing is $0.50 a page, flat mailers cost more, and heavier letters need extra stamps.

blocks.p: Every price is the sum of four lines: a mailing fee and an envelope, per envelope, plus printing per page, plus postage per stamp. Postage is passed through at cost, with no margin.

These examples are double-sided, the default. Printing is priced per page, not per sheet, but weight sets the stamps: single-sided, the same three pages plus the address page are four sheets, about 31 g, which needs the $1.75 band and two stamps. The address page on a #10 window envelope is not billed, though it adds weight.

ul: **Pages.** Each page adds its printing rate, and the weight eventually needs more stamps; see [how many stamps a letter needs](/blog/how-many-stamps-for-a-letter-in-canada).
**Flat envelope.** Larger mailers cost more and are oversize Lettermail, which needs three stamps minimum: [postage for a large envelope](/blog/postage-for-a-large-envelope-canada).
**Too many pages for one envelope.** A letter that will not fit is split into several mailings, each with its own fee and stamps.

blocks.p: Sending many letters by API, the mailing fee falls automatically from $0.99 to $0.20 by your 100th mailing in any 30 days, and the cheapest letter costs as low as $1.69 all in. Postage stays at cost. [The rate table and a calculator](/blog/api-volume-pricing) show other page counts and envelopes.
